reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 14.1 confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data, Confidential Information and pre-existing IP with only a limited processing right to Vendor.
Section 14.2 vests Deliverables in Customer with an express Vendor assignment plus personnel assignments and further assurances, matching the preferred position on work product.

Section 14.3 limits Vendor to Vendor Technology (defined at 1.9 to exclude Customer Data and Customer pre-existing IP) and pulls in the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works from embedded Vendor Technology — satisfying the licence-back requirement.

Section 14.4 negates joint ownership absent a signed instrument specifying exploitation rights, and feedback use is limited with Customer retaining unrestricted rights, so no walk-away trigger is present.

No redline or counterparty comment is expected or offered for a compliant finding; the deterministic check confirming no residual assignment of Customer IP/data to Vendor is consistent, and the paragraphs are unmodified.

Only immaterial imprecision: the rationale cites Section 15.1 text not included in the supplied paragraphs, but the compliance conclusion rests on Sections 13.2 and 14.1–14.4, which are quoted in full.
